## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation, not just the
solution you have in mind.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, or links that help explain the request. If it touches the
alarm/notification pipeline, please note that — that area is the app's core and
changes are discussed before implementation.
